name: Football Charts
description: Football Charts API v1: football league tables, match results, upcoming fixtures with calibrated Dixon-Coles probabilities, 10,000-run Monte Carlo season projections, 15-minute goal-timing distributions and public model calibration records across 98 leagues in 44 countries. Read-only; works without a key, a free key raises the daily quota.
instructions:
## Football Charts
This connector reads the **Football Charts Developer API v1** (`https://footballcharts-backend.onrender.com/api/v1`, documented at `https://www.football-charts.com/developers`): league standings, finished match results with half-time scores and first-goal minutes, upcoming fixtures with calibrated Dixon-Coles (`dc_v2`) model probabilities, daily 10,000-run Monte Carlo season projections, 15-minute goal-timing distributions and the public model calibration track record across 98 football leagues in 44 countries (top divisions, lower tiers and women's leagues). Everything is read-only. Football Charts publishes statistical probabilities and a settled calibration record, not betting advice or bookmaker odds.

## Setup and tiers
- **No key needed**: every tool works without an API key at **100 requests per day per IP** (20 per minute).
- **Free key (optional)**: register a free key for personal use at `https://www.football-charts.com/developers` and put it in `FOOTBALL_CHARTS_API_KEY`. It is sent as the `X-API-Key` header and raises the quota to **200 requests per day per email address** (60 per minute).
- **Season coverage**: both the keyless tier and the free key cover all 98 leagues for the **current and previous season** of each league. Paid API plans unlock historical seasons back to 2020 and per-match statistics on results; querying an older season on the free tier answers **403** (`season_gated`).

## League keys, seasons and slugs
- Competition keys are lowercase strings such as `premier` (Premier League), `cha` (Championship), `spain1` (LaLiga), `germany1` (Bundesliga), `italy1` (Serie A), `france1` (Ligue 1), `brazil1` (Brasileirao), `sweden1` (Allsvenskan) or `wgermany1` (Frauen-Bundesliga). Call `football_charts_list_leagues` first to get the exact `league` key and `seasons` array.
- Season format depends on the competition calendar: winter-calendar leagues use `YYYY-YYYY` (for example `2026-2027`), while summer-calendar leagues use `YYYY` (for example `2026`). Omit `season` to read the current season.
- Team slugs in `football_charts_get_team` are lowercase hyphenated names (such as `arsenal` or `manchester-city`), listed by `football_charts_list_teams`.
- Match slugs in `football_charts_get_match` have the form `country/league-slug/YYYY-MM-DD-home-vs-away` and come from `football_charts_get_fixtures`.
- All dates and times are UTC (`kickoff_utc` on finished matches, `match_date` and `time` on fixtures). Every answer includes `source_url`, the canonical `football-charts.com` page showing the same data.

## Workflow
- Discover competitions and season strings: `football_charts_list_leagues`.
- Standings and underlying performance: `football_charts_get_league_table` (`view=classic` orders by points, `view=luck` by points minus expected points, `view=goals` by goals scored).
- Results and form: `football_charts_get_results` for a whole league season or filtered to one club with `team`.
- Upcoming matches and probabilities: `football_charts_get_fixtures` for the league schedule with `dc_v2.calibrated` probabilities (draw probability is `1 - home - away`), then `football_charts_get_match` with a `slug` for full match details and first-goal-time histograms.
- Title, top-four and relegation simulations: `football_charts_get_season_projection`.
- Scoring intervals and club profiles: `football_charts_get_goal_timing`, `football_charts_list_teams` and `football_charts_get_team`.
- Model calibration audit: `football_charts_get_track_record` returns hit rate, Brier score, reliability buckets and recent settled predictions.

FOOTBALL_CHARTS_API_KEY.label: API key (optional)
FOOTBALL_CHARTS_API_KEY.help: Leave empty to use the keyless tier (100 requests/day per IP, 20/min). Register a free key for personal use at football-charts.com/developers to raise the limit to 200 requests/day per email address (60/min).
FOOTBALL_CHARTS_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste a Football Charts API key starting with fc_, without spaces.

verifyHints.401: Football Charts did not recognise the API key. Paste a key starting with fc_ from football-charts.com/developers, or leave FOOTBALL_CHARTS_API_KEY empty for the keyless tier.
verifyHints.403: This season is outside the free window (current and previous season per league) or the API key has been disabled.
verifyHints.429: Rate limit reached (100/day, 20/min without a key; 200/day, 60/min with a free key). Wait a minute or add a free API key.

tools.name: football_charts_list_leagues
tools.description: List all 98 football leagues covered across 44 countries with their competition key, display name, country, available season strings (newest first) and canonical football-charts.com URL. Call this first to find valid league keys and season strings.

tools.name: football_charts_get_league_table
tools.description: Get the standings table of a league season: position, played, won, drawn, lost, goals for and against, goal difference, points, last-five form, expected points and luck classification. Supports ordering by points (classic), over/under-performance (luck) or goals scored (goals).

league.description: League key from football_charts_list_leagues, e.g. premier, cha, spain1, germany1, italy1, france1, brazil1, sweden1 or wgermany1.

season.description: Season string from football_charts_list_leagues, e.g. 2026-2027 for winter leagues or 2026 for summer leagues. Defaults to the current season.

view.description: Table ordering: classic (by points), luck (by points minus expected points) or goals (by goals scored).

tools.name: football_charts_get_results
tools.description: List finished matches of a league season in chronological order with UTC date and kickoff time, home and away teams, full-time and half-time scores, first-goal minute and stoppage-time offset. Optionally filter by team name substring.

league.description: League key from football_charts_list_leagues, e.g. premier, spain1 or brazil1.

season.description: Season string from football_charts_list_leagues, e.g. 2026-2027 or 2026. Defaults to the current season.

team.description: Case-insensitive team name substring to filter matches where either side matches, e.g. Liverpool or Flamengo.

tools.name: football_charts_get_fixtures
tools.description: List upcoming fixtures for a league ordered by kickoff time with UTC date and time, match slug and calibrated Dixon-Coles (dc_v2) probabilities for home win, away win, over/under goal lines and both teams to score (draw probability is 1 minus home minus away).

league.description: League key from football_charts_list_leagues, e.g. premier, spain1 or germany1.

tools.name: football_charts_get_season_projection
tools.description: Get the daily 10,000-run Monte Carlo season projection for a league's current season: each team's title, top-four and relegation (bottom-three) probabilities, current points, mean final points, 10th-to-90th percentile points range, finishing-position matrix and change since the previous run.

league.description: League key from football_charts_list_leagues, e.g. premier, spain1 or italy1.

tools.name: football_charts_get_goal_timing
tools.description: Get goals scored per 15-minute match interval (0-15, 15-30, 30-45, 45+, 46-60, 60-75, 75-90, 90+) for every team in a league season, with each team's peak scoring period(s), late-goal share from minute 75 onward and first-half share.

league.description: League key from football_charts_list_leagues, e.g. premier, spain1 or brazil1.

season.description: Season string from football_charts_list_leagues, e.g. 2026-2027 or 2026. Defaults to the current season.

team.description: Optional case-insensitive team name substring to narrow the output to matching teams.

tools.name: football_charts_list_teams
tools.description: List all teams competing in a league season in standings order with their team slugs and summary records. Use the returned slug values with football_charts_get_team.

league.description: League key from football_charts_list_leagues, e.g. premier, spain1 or germany1.

season.description: Season string from football_charts_list_leagues, e.g. 2026-2027 or 2026. Defaults to the current season.

tools.name: football_charts_get_team
tools.description: Get one team's season profile in a league: standings row with expected points and luck classification, full match log, 15-minute goal-timing breakdown, first-goal distribution and season match-statistic averages where covered.

league.description: League key from football_charts_list_leagues, e.g. premier or spain1.

team.description: Lowercase hyphenated team slug from football_charts_list_teams, e.g. arsenal or manchester-city.

season.description: Season string from football_charts_list_leagues, e.g. 2026-2027 or 2026. Defaults to the current season.

tools.name: football_charts_get_match
tools.description: Get one match in full by its slug (country/league-slug/YYYY-MM-DD-home-vs-away): calibrated and raw Dixon-Coles probabilities, team attack and defence ratings, first-goal-time histograms for both sides and full-time/half-time scores once played.

tools.name: football_charts_get_track_record
tools.description: Get the public calibration track record of the Football Charts probability model over settled matches: total scored predictions, hit rate, Brier score, reliability buckets comparing predicted probabilities with observed frequencies, breakdown by market and recent settled predictions.

days.description: Lookback window in days (1 to 365, default 90).
